value.story: Founded in 2001 in Vijayapura by Dr. Prabhugouda B. Lingadalli, Anugraha Eye Hospital has evolved into North Karnataka preeminent ophthalmic institution. Guided by the core tenets of Authentic, Affectionate, and Affordable eye care, the hospital has restored sight to over 2.28 lakh patients and screened millions across rural communities.
value.vision: Sight for all through Authentic, Affectionate and Affordable treatment and eradication of blindness through quality Eye care services.
value.history: In 2001, Dr. Lingadalli established Anugraha Eye Hospital with a vision to eliminate preventable blindness in North Karnataka. Beginning as a specialized eye clinic in Vijayapura, the institution pioneered mobile outreach eye camps, reaching remote villages with free surgical care. Today, the hospital encompasses 2 super-specialty tertiary base hospitals in Vijayapura and Kalaburagi, 8 rural Vision Centers, and RGUHS-affiliated optometry and DNB residency academic programs.
value.mission: Deliver quality, accessible eye care to all; excel in specialized eye care services; become a preferred destination for medical, paramedical and non-medical professionals; deploy advanced technology; promote preventive eye care and eye donation.

value.education: Regular eye examinations prevent asymptomatic conditions such as glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, and age-related macular degeneration. Protect your eyes with UV-blocking sunglasses, take frequent screen breaks using the 20-20-20 rule, and maintain healthy glycemic levels.
value.patientInfo: Anugraha Eye Hospital welcomes patients for both routine visual evaluations and advanced surgical consultations. Please bring any existing spectacle prescriptions, medical records, and government ID/health insurance cards to facilitate cashless registration.
value.emergencyInfo: 24/7 emergency ophthalmic services are active at our Vijayapura Main Campus and Kalaburagi Base Hospital for chemical burns, severe ocular trauma, acute angle-closure glaucoma, and sudden vision loss. Helpline: 08352-220646.

value.appointmentInfo: OPD appointments are available Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Walk-in patients are registered on a first-come, first-served basis, with priority triage for emergency eye trauma and elderly patients.

value.question: Is cataract surgery painful, and how long does recovery take?
value.answer: At Anugraha Eye Hospital, cataract surgery is performed using topical anesthetic eye drops without injections or stitches (MICS). The procedure takes approximately 10 to 15 minutes, and patients can resume normal daily activities within 24 to 48 hours.

value.question: What cashless insurance schemes are accepted at Anugraha?
value.answer: We accept major government welfare programs including Ayushman Bharat – Arogya Karnataka (AB-ARK), ECHS, and KPTCL, as well as leading private insurance TPAs like Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Medi Assist, and Vidal Health.

value.question: Who is eligible for LASIK / Contoura Vision laser surgery?
value.answer: Candidates should be at least 18 years old, have had a stable glasses prescription for at least 12 months, and possess healthy corneas verified through our pre-LASIK Pentacam topography and pachymetry evaluation.

value.question: How often should diabetic patients get their eyes checked?
value.answer: All diabetic individuals should undergo a dilated fundus eye examination and OCT scan at least once every 6 to 12 months to detect early diabetic retinopathy before irreversible vision loss occurs.

value.question: Do rural Vision Centers provide free doctor consultations?
value.answer: Yes, all 8 rural Vision Centers conduct free Sunday OPD triage camps with visiting consultant ophthalmic surgeons from the Vijayapura Base Hospital, in addition to weekday computerized eye examinations.
